provenance.geometry: auto-detected from the plan view in the Reloop Ready instruction manual (article 243598), scaled to the published 325 x 220 mm; deriving the scale from width alone reproduces the published depth to 0.9%, so the drawing is a true orthographic projection
provenance.names: from the manual's numbered callouts resolved through its DESIGNATIONS legend
provenance.bindings: none: nobody has run a learn pass on this hardware yet
provenance.led_colour: RGB encoding recovered on hardware 2026-09-18 by lighting pads at computed velocities and reading the colours off the panel; confirmed by predicting eight pure colours that had never been sent

led.note: velocity = bright<<6 | R<<4 | G<<2 | B, each component 0..3. Verified on hardware: 64 colours, two brightness levels. Only the performance pads are RGB.

pad_modes.note: Holding MODE and pressing a pad selects a performance mode. Mixxx has no pad modes, so the mapping keeps the mode itself.

jog.note: Rim, platter and VINYL work as one control. VINYL arms the touch sensor; armed and touched, the rim scratches, otherwise it nudges.
